summary: Automation: test-account provisioning workflow failing for contractor accounts
description: Since 2026-03-18 the onboarding automation that provisions short-lived test accounts for contractor cohorts fails during the SAML assertion exchange. The job logs show a 403 from the identity provider (IdP) with 'invalid audience' and occasional time skew errors. Steps to reproduce: 1) Run pipeline redwood/onboarding/automation with contractor flag; 2) Observe SAML assertion attempt to idp-staging.redwood.com; 3) Job exits with code 1 after retry attempts. Impact: Contractors cannot access staging environments which blocks several POCs and test runs. Workaround: Manual account creation through console by infra-auth leads with a note to disable automation. Hypothesis: recent cert rotation on idp-staging changed expected audience or clock drift on the pipeline runner. Next action requested: assign to infra-auth, capture IdP request/response and rotate test certs if needed. Attach logs: staging/onboard/job-20260318.log (referenced).
